## Live defect
PC01 live evidence 2026-09-21 ~19:53 +07:
- GH-1334 lastActivityAt=2026-09-21T12:36:44Z while NV02 remained WORKING/uiBusy/stopVisible until periodic F5 around 12:53:55Z.
- Controller recovery.attempts.NV02 stayed 0.
- After periodic F5, NV02 briefly became STALLED then READY; GH-1334 reached DONE at 12:54:15Z.
- Owner screenshot shows ChatGPT spinner/stop button hung with repeated continue prompts and no visible progress.

## Root cause to verify
direct-cdp-bridge continuity currently gates WORKING progress checks behind `if(now < state.nextContinueAt) return`, so a UI that falsely reports WORKING can evade semantic-progress checks until the random continue/F5 window. Current STALLED path reloads but does not escalate to bounded close/reopen when reload does not restore progress.

## Required
1. WORKING semantic-progress watchdog must run independently of the continue-send timer.
2. If WORKING signature is unchanged for bounded checks/time, recover without waiting for next natural continue.
3. Recovery ladder: stop/clear safely -> F5 -> re-check -> bounded planned close/reopen only if still stalled, preserving current job/chat identity where possible.
4. Periodic F5 remains 5–10 min but must not reset evidence in a way that masks a persistent hang.
5. Never send duplicate prompts while uiBusy/WORKING.
6. Preserve one browser mutation owner, security/auth/rate-limit gates, model profile guard, current-work-only semantics, and no backlog selection in Direct-CDP.
7. Add regression tests reproducing WORKING=true + unchanged activity signature for >3 checks and proving recovery escalation.
8. branch -> PR -> exact-head checks -> independent review -> reversible live canary on NV02.
9. Evidence must include timestamps showing detection/recovery without Owner intervention.

DONE only with live PC01 evidence.

## Additional confirmed defect — chat rotation never executes
Owner screenshot 2026-09-21 shows the long NV02 chat still being reused and loading very slowly, while ChatGPT Go does not show the same symptom.

Live/runtime evidence:
- continuity state after reboot: `dispatchesInChat=46`, old `chatStartedAt`, and `nextRefreshAt` already overdue.
- NV02 renderer working set reached ~651 MB on the long ChatGPT thread.
- `rotateNv02Chat()` exists in `apps/chrome-controller/direct-cdp-bridge.mjs` and correctly implements durable save -> archive -> new chat -> model verify -> continue.
- But current `maybeNv02Continuity()` never calls `rotateNv02Chat()`; therefore the long-thread rotation path is dead code.
- Result: NV02 keeps reopening/reloading the same large conversation, accumulating DOM/history and increasing page hydration/load latency. This directly explains why reboot/F5 alone does not cure the slow Plus tab.

Additional required acceptance:
10. Wire an explicit bounded rotation gate into `maybeNv02Continuity()` using overdue `nextRefreshAt` and/or chat age/dispatch count, only when safe/idle and current chat is tracked.
11. Rotation must be: durable checkpoint receipt -> archive current chat -> create new chat in TigerIQ project -> verify GPT-5.6 Sol High -> resume current assigned work.
12. Add regression proving overdue rotation actually invokes `rotateNv02Chat()`; dead/unreachable rotation code is not acceptable.
13. Live canary must show dispatch count/chat age reset after rotation and materially improved page load/ready latency without losing job continuity.


## AUTO HANDOFF CHAIN — 2026-09-21
- #1358 is the independent repair prerequisite and is already claimed by Coding Lane.
- When #1358 closes completed, this issue auto-releases to NV02 only for live continuity/canary acceptance.
- No Owner/Vy prompt is required between #1358 completion and this acceptance.


## OWNER RUNTIME RESUME — 2026-09-21 22:45 +07
- Private Owner↔Vy maintenance authorization: restore NV02 execution now.
- #1349 live continuity/recovery acceptance may run in PARALLEL with remaining #1358 source hardening.
- Do not close #1349 until live evidence passes; do not block NV02 merely because #1358 remains open.
- Core remains sole dispatcher; NV02 executes assigned work only.
